name: context-forge
description: A context-engineering toolkit for AI coding agents. context-constitution reverse-engineers a repo's non-obvious tribal knowledge into an evidence-cited context-constitution.md plus a behavioral contract in CLAUDE.md; context-scrubber audits the repo's context files and reports every line that fails the litmus test — stale citations, restated facts, cross-file duplication, contradicted-by-code, should-be-just-in-time, brittle/over-specified, bloat — plus two file-level advisories, a context-budget rot check and a silent-skill (weak trigger surface) audit, with an optional gated trim. Adds the high-signal context, removes the low-signal; invents nothing, every rule and verdict is grounded.

interface.shortDescription: Put the knowledge an agent needs into your context files, and get everything else out.
